command:
set -eu
sudo install -d -m 0700 /root
sudo dd if=/dev/urandom of=/root/.secure-volume.key bs=64 count=1 status=none
sudo chmod 0600 /root/.secure-volume.key
sudo fallocate -l 512M /var/lib/secure-volume.luks
sudo chmod 0600 /var/lib/secure-volume.luks
sudo cryptsetup luksFormat --type luks2 --batch-mode --key-file /root/.secure-volume.key /var/lib/secure-volume.luks
printf 'luks_created='; sudo cryptsetup isLuks /var/lib/secure-volume.luks && printf 'yes\n'
sudo stat -c 'key_mode=%a key_owner=%U:%G container_size=%s' /root/.secure-volume.key
sudo stat -c 'container_mode=%a container_owner=%U:%G' /var/lib/secure-volume.luks

command:
set -eu
sudo cryptsetup open --key-file /root/.secure-volume.key /var/lib/secure-volume.luks secure
sudo mkfs.ext4 -q -L SECURE /dev/mapper/secure
sudo install -d -m 0750 /srv/secure
sudo mount /dev/mapper/secure /srv/secure
printf 'encrypted payload survives automatic reboot mount\n' | sudo tee /srv/secure/recovery-proof.txt >/dev/null
sudo chmod 0640 /srv/secure/recovery-proof.txt
sync
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /srv/secure
sudo cryptsetup status secure
sudo cat /srv/secure/recovery-proof.txt

command:
set -eu
sudo systemctl stop srv-secure.mount
sudo systemctl stop systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service
if mountpoint -q /srv/secure; then printf 'mount_stopped=no\n'; exit 1; else printf 'mount_stopped=yes\n'; fi
if sudo cryptsetup status secure >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'mapping_closed=no\n'; exit 1; else printf 'mapping_closed=yes\n'; fi
sudo systemctl start srv-secure.mount
printf 'mount_unit='; systemctl is-active srv-secure.mount
printf 'crypt_unit='; systemctl is-active systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /srv/secure
sudo cat /srv/secure/recovery-proof.txt
